description: Fail-closed C++/Rust shared-corpus feature execution matrix. Static C++ surface gates are tracked as active gaps until native C++ runners emit comparable shared-case reports.

open_blockers: C++ shared-corpus execution still has temporary static surface gates.
Feature parity cannot be complete until product-behavior shared cases have native C++ execution or an approved native adapter contract.

Static or mixed C++ native execution gaps remain for families: storage/cache, raft, context, client/proxy/control-plane, ingestion, benchmarks, ops/scale, codex/mcp, Redis/admin, client_proxy_control_plane, product_api_models.
